title: THE BUSINESS OF SPORT
description: Examines the business dynamics and structure of the sports industry. Considers various perspectives, including professional, amateur, emerging, and global sports structures and addresses current issues in labor relations, media, and the financial and societal implications of sports business.
registration_restrictions: Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.
